tool.name: ampvis2 alpha diversity
tool.description: Calculate alpha-diversity indices for each sample and combines with the metadata.
tool.command:
Rscript --vanilla <<__RSCRIPT__ library(ampvis2) library(vegan) library(ggplot2)
input_rds <- readRDS("${input}") alpha_div <- amp_alpha_diversity(input_rds)
write.csv(alpha_div, file="${output}", row.names=TRUE) __RSCRIPT__

param.name: input
param.label: Input ampvis2 RDS dataset
param.help: An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained from previous ampvis2 tools.

data.name: output
data.label: Alpha diversity results
data.description: Tabular dataset containing alpha-diversity measures per sample

tool.help:
# What it does
Calculate alpha-diversity indices for each sample and combines with the metadata.
# Usage
This tool uses the `amp_alpha_diversity` function from the ampvis2 package to calculate alpha-diversity indices. The indices are calculated using vegan's `diversity` and `rrarefy` functions.
# Input
An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained from previous ampvis2 tools.
# Output
A tabular dataset containing alpha-diversity measures per sample.
